result_text:
I made the purchase-order-per-rep report skip cancelled purchase orders. Nothing is committed.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery, which is the same filter the other per-rep counts use. I also added a line to the method's Javadoc saying cancelled purchase orders are left out.

The sort order (highest count first) and the zero rows for reps without purchase orders are unchanged.

I didn't check your Anna/Bob example directly. I ran `mvn -q -o test -Dtest='*SalesRep*'` and it printed no output. No test in `src/test` references this method, so that run doesn't exercise the change.
